landing.faq.stack.question: What's the tech stack?
landing.faq.stack.answer: Next.js 16 with the App Router, React 19, TypeScript strict mode, Tailwind CSS 4, shadcn/ui, Drizzle ORM, and better-auth. Every piece of business logic is inlined — no external packages for payment, email, storage, or AI.
landing.faq.payment.question: Which payment providers are supported?
landing.faq.payment.answer: Payment methods will be announced after the checkout integration is configured and tested.
landing.faq.database.question: Which databases can I use?
landing.faq.database.answer: Drizzle ORM handles PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Turso, and Cloudflare D1. Switch providers by editing DATABASE_PROVIDER in your .env — the schema templates and drizzle config adapt automatically.
landing.faq.customize.question: How customizable is the landing page?
landing.faq.customize.answer: The src/blocks/ directory ships with demo sections — they're designed to be rewritten per project. The durable primitives live in src/components/, so your rebrand touches blocks and translations, not the chassis.
landing.faq.license.question: Can I use this for commercial projects?
landing.faq.license.answer: Usage terms will be published with each supported model before public launch.

stp.pricing.faq1_q: How do credits work on Genematic AI?
stp.pricing.faq1_a: Credits are deducted per generation based on the selected AI model and settings (video costs vary by model, duration, and resolution). You only pay for what you generate.
stp.pricing.faq2_q: Are there any recurring subscriptions or hidden fees?
stp.pricing.faq2_a: No! All our plans are one-time credit purchases. You are never automatically billed or charged recurring monthly fees.
stp.pricing.faq3_a: Credits remain valid according to the duration of the purchased tier (1 month for Starter, 3 months for Standard, and 1 full year for Premium).
stp.pricing.faq4_q: Can I upgrade or buy more credits anytime?
stp.pricing.faq4_a: Yes, you can top up credits whenever needed. Credits from new packages add directly to your current balance.

landing.logos.title: Powered by Industry-Leading AI Video & Diffusion Models
landing.hero.description_full: Fast AI Image Editing and Cinematic AI Video Generation. Transform ideas into stunning films and breathe life into static photos.
landing.core_features.title: Genematic AI Core Capabilities
landing.core_features.desc: Empowering creators with a complete, end-to-end generative suite designed for professional visual storytelling.
landing.core_features.f1_desc: Edit any photo with conversational instructions. Genematic AI translates complex creative intent into pinpoint pixel transformations.
landing.core_features.f2_desc: Choose text-to-video or image-to-video, describe the scene, and review the available output settings in the workspace.
landing.core_features.f3_desc: Preserve facial identity, costumes, and distinct physical traits across scenes and continuous shot sequences.
landing.core_features.f4_desc: Blend elements from multiple reference visuals to construct original environments, match palettes, or guide motion trajectory.
landing.core_features.f5_desc: Tailor pixel-perfect outputs for YouTube (16:9), TikTok/Reels (9:16), or Instagram/Square (1:1) in a single click.
landing.core_features.f6_desc: Regenerate camera angles, adjust ambient lighting, and cycle through style variations in seconds without starting over.
landing.benefits.title: Redefining AI Visual Creation
landing.benefits.desc: Genematic AI integrates world-leading image synthesis and motion technologies to make professional-grade creation as intuitive as a conversation.
landing.benefits.b1_desc: Complete the entire creative process from text-to-image to final video output seamlessly in one integrated platform.
landing.benefits.b2_desc: Unique identity-aware models ensure your virtual characters remain highly consistent across images and motion shots.
landing.benefits.b3_desc: Review your output and the applicable model terms before publishing. Commercial usage rights are not guaranteed for every output.
landing.steps.title: Three Simple Steps to Magic
landing.steps.desc: Turn spontaneous creative thoughts into cinema-grade production assets in under a minute.
landing.steps.s1_desc: Enter descriptive prompts in natural language, or upload a reference image to anchor character features and lighting.
landing.steps.s2_desc: Pick between flagship image generators or cinematic video motion engines with tailored aspect ratios (16:9, 9:16, 1:1).
landing.steps.s3_desc: Follow the task status, preview the completed clip, and download the available video file.
landing.testimonials.main_desc: Bring a photo, a prompt, or a rough idea and shape it into a polished visual with a focused workflow.
landing.testimonials.stat1_desc: Animate a still image with a guided prompt.
landing.testimonials.stat2_desc: Generate or edit visuals from text and references.
landing.testimonials.stat3_desc: Start with the available free credits and see the workflow.
landing.testimonials.t1_quote: The Genematic AI engine completely flipped my workflow. What used to take a full production team now materializes in minutes with consistent visual identity.
landing.testimonials.t2_quote: I was looking for a platform that wasn’t clunky or restrained by low fps limits. Genematic AI exceeded all expectations in both control and render fidelity.
landing.testimonials.t3_quote: The image-to-video AI feature brings dynamic cinematic motion to my photo shoots. My commercial brand clients are perpetually blown away.
landing.testimonials.t4_quote: The prompt comprehension is otherworldly. I can sketch or describe an atmosphere and receive production-ready lighting and composition on the first try.
landing.faq.main_desc: Everything you need to know about generations, models, and creative workflows.
landing.faq.q1: How do I generate the best AI videos from text?
landing.faq.a1: To achieve optimal cinematic results, be explicit regarding lighting, camera motion (e.g. "slow pan", "orbit shot"), aesthetic genre, and subject focus in your prompts.
landing.faq.q2: What makes Genematic AI useful for visual work?
landing.faq.a2: It brings image creation, image editing, and image-to-video workflows into one focused studio so you can move from an idea to a usable draft quickly.
landing.faq.q3: Can I start generating images and videos for free?
landing.faq.a3: Yes! Upon creating an account, complimentary initial credits are granted so you can experiment with flagship text-to-image and image-to-video generation.
landing.faq.q4: Does image-to-video work with real-world photographs?
landing.faq.a4: Absolutely. Whether high-res studio photography, architectural portraits, or digital illustrations, our motion generator extracts depth layers to produce natural motion.
landing.cta.banner_title: Turn your next idea into a visual
landing.cta.banner_desc: Unleash the full potential of AI image and video production. Create unforgettable films, animations, and concept art in seconds.

admin.agent.skill_prompt:
Please add "{app}" ({url}) as a ShipAny project you can manage, under the project name "{name}".

1. If you don't have the shipany-admin skill yet, download these two files into a shipany-admin folder in your skills directory (e.g. ~/.claude/skills/shipany-admin/). If it's already installed, skip this step and don't overwrite it: the client can read every project's key, so update it only when I explicitly ask, from a site I trust.
   - {url}/api/admin/agent/skill?file=SKILL.md → shipany-admin/SKILL.md
   - {url}/api/admin/agent/skill?file=admin-client.mjs → shipany-admin/scripts/admin-client.mjs
2. I'll send you this project's admin key (starts with sa_admin_) next. Save it via stdin — never as a command argument — and never repeat it afterwards:
   printf '%s' '<key>' | node <skill-dir>/scripts/admin-client.mjs add {name} {url}
3. Run node <skill-dir>/scripts/admin-client.mjs --project {name} list and tell me which operations you can call.
4. From then on, follow SKILL.md strictly for the admin tasks I give you; when managing several projects, name the project with --project on every call.
admin.agent.full_docs: Full reference (idempotency, audit, local stdio MCP bridge, CLI agent/key management): docs/admin-agent.md in the repository.
admin.agent.never_warning: A non-expiring key works until you revoke it. Give the agent minimal roles, and revoke the key as soon as it's no longer needed or may have leaked.
admin.agent.created_warning: Copy this key now — it won't be shown again. Store it in the agent's secret store, never in the repository.
admin.agent.revoke_warning: Revoke this key? Agents using it lose access immediately. This can't be undone.
admin.agent.accounts_hint: Each agent is an API-type user: its permissions are the RBAC roles you assign, and it signs in only with its admin API keys. Agents aren't counted as users.
admin.agent.agent_form_hint: Pick the roles this agent acts with. You can only grant roles whose permissions you hold yourself.
admin.agent.no_agents: No agents yet. Create one, assign roles, then issue a key.
admin.agent.keys_hint: Admin API keys (sa_admin_…) for this agent. Only a hash is stored; a key is shown once. They never work on the product API.
admin.agent.delete_warning: The agent account, its role assignments and all its keys are removed. Agents using them lose access immediately. Its execution history is kept.
admin.analytics.title: Conversion Funnel
admin.analytics.description: Sign-up → checkout → paid, for users who signed up in the selected window. Sliced by first-touch source.
admin.analytics.empty_hint: Only users who signed up in this window are counted — payments from earlier sign-ups appear under Revenue, not here.
admin.analytics.footnote: Counts are distinct users; refunded payments still count as paid. Checkouts and payments made after the window still count toward its cohort; subscription renewals are excluded. Attribution is first-touch, captured at sign-up — users who signed up before utm_medium / utm_content / referrer tracking shipped show as (none).
admin.user_detail.title: User Details
admin.user_detail.attribution_desc: First-touch source captured when the user signed up
admin.payments.refund_description: Refunds the full amount through {provider} and deducts the credits from the user. This cannot be undone.
admin.payments.refund_credits_hint: This order granted {credits} credits. Taken from the order's unspent credits first, then the user's other credits; the balance never goes below 0.
admin.payments.refund_credits_invalid: Credits must be a whole number ≥ 0
admin.payments.refund_pending: Refund submitted (provider is processing), {credits} credits deducted
admin.payments.refund_credits_short: Only {deducted} of {requested} credits could be deducted (insufficient balance)
admin.payments.refund_cancel_failed: Refunded, but cancelling the subscription failed: {error}
admin.credits.search_placeholder: Transaction / order no, email, name, ID...
admin.settings.groups.cookie_consent.des: Show a cookie banner to visitors. Until they accept, Google Analytics runs in Consent Mode (no cookies) and AdSense ads are not loaded. Plausible is cookieless and unaffected.
admin.settings.tips.cookie_consent_enabl: Recommended if you serve visitors in the EU/UK and use Google Analytics or AdSense.
admin.settings.tips.notify_ticket_enable: A user opens a ticket or replies to one. Admin replies are not pushed.
admin.settings.groups.notify_settings.de: Choose which events push a message to the bots below
admin.settings.groups.notify_wecom.title: WeCom Bot
admin.settings.tips.notify_timezone: IANA time zone for the times in messages. Defaults to Asia/Shanghai.
admin.settings.tips.telegram_bot_token: Message @BotFather in Telegram, send /newbot and follow the prompts; it replies with the token.
admin.settings.tips.telegram_chat_id: Where messages go. Private chat: open your bot in Telegram and press Start. Group: add the bot and send /start@your_bot there. Channel: make the bot an admin and post once. Then click the link above and copy chat.id from the result. Group and channel IDs start with -100; a public channel can also use @channelname.
admin.settings.telegram_get_chat_id: Open getUpdates to find your Chat ID
admin.settings.telegram_token_masked: Re-enter the Bot Token above to show a link for finding the Chat ID.
admin.settings.tips.telegram_api_base: Optional. Set a reverse proxy if your server can't reach api.telegram.org.
admin.settings.tips.feishu_webhook_url: In the Feishu/Lark group: Settings → Group bots → Add bot → Custom bot, then copy the webhook URL. Lark (open.larksuite.com) URLs work too.
admin.settings.tips.feishu_secret: Recommended. In the bot's security settings, tick "Signature verification" and paste the secret here. Avoid "Custom keywords" (messages without the keyword are dropped) and IP allowlists (Cloudflare and other hosts have changing IPs).
admin.settings.tips.wecom_webhook_url: Group chat settings → Message Push (formerly "Group Bot") → Add, then copy the webhook URL.
admin.settings.groups.notify_webhook.des: POST JSON to any endpoint — AI agents and automations (Grok bot, Cursor routine, Zapier, n8n…)
admin.settings.tips.notify_webhook_url: Works with Grok bots, Cursor automations, Zapier, n8n or your own endpoint. Each event is POSTed as JSON with event (payment.succeeded / ticket.created / ticket.replied), test, text (the same message the bots get), data (raw fields) and sent_at.
admin.settings.tips.notify_webhook_token: Optional. Sent as "Authorization: Bearer <token>" — paste the key your endpoint gives you.
admin.users.set_password_description: Set a new sign-in password for {name}. They will be signed out on all devices. Users who only signed in with Google/GitHub can then also sign in with their email and this password.
admin.users.password_updated: Password updated; the user has been signed out
admin.users.password_too_short: Password must be at least 8 characters
admin.settings.tips.plausible_src: Paste the script URL from Plausible. Accepted: an https URL on plausible.io, or a same-site proxy path like /js/script.js. For self-hosted Plausible, add its host to the server env var PLAUSIBLE_SCRIPT_HOSTS (comma-separated), then restart or redeploy. No rebuild needed.

genematic.face_swap.faq1_a: You can start with free credits. Longer videos and additional generations use credits.
genematic.face_swap.faq2_q: Do I need to sign up?
genematic.face_swap.faq2_a: The page and workflow are available to explore without sign-up. An account may be required to save generations.
genematic.face_swap.faq3_q: Will my video have a watermark?
genematic.face_swap.faq3_a: The workflow is designed for clean exports. The final result depends on the generation mode and account plan.
genematic.face_swap.faq4_q: How long can my video be?
genematic.face_swap.faq4_a: Start with short clips. Available duration depends on the selected model and the credits in your account.
genematic.face_swap.faq5_q: Can I swap more than one face in one video?
genematic.face_swap.faq5_a: Multi-face workflows depend on the selected model and the source video. Use a clear clip for the best result.
genematic.face_swap.faq6_q: Do I need to install an app?
genematic.face_swap.faq6_a: No. Genematicai works in a modern browser on desktop and mobile.
genematic.face_swap.faq7_a: Most renders take from a few seconds to a couple of minutes, depending on the model and queue.
genematic.face_swap.faq8_a: Use common image and video formats such as JPG, PNG, MP4, and MOV.
genematic.face_swap.faq9_q: Is Genematicai the same as Genematic?
genematic.face_swap.faq9_a: Genematicai is an independent third-party AI video tool and is not affiliated with any similarly named brand.
